pricing.basis: identity break = one lost trail (that walker's remaining steps); rate charged at the exact CP-95 upper bound on the per-TRAIL rate, NOT divided by the walker count
pricing.v19_error: v19 divided a per-walker probability by 2^20 and claimed 5.845e-09; that division is wrong (each dead walker loses its own work, so the loss fraction is the per-trail rate) and the underlying zero was measured on coefficient pairs, not states

return_positive_control.why: same tracker, tiny group q=1031 where S returns are certain

structural_argument.consequence: an S return at a different phase does not stop progress; it is a collision subtype whose relation is tested by the shipped predicate (measured useful / trivial above)
structural_argument.statement: the row index is prod = (S XOR (t*2654435761 mod 2^64) XOR trail*7919) mod R, so the next state is a function of (S, t) and t increases strictly inside a trail; the pair (S, t) never recurs, therefore a walker's future never repeats and the classical rho-cycle death does not exist on this walk

unit: trail = one walker's walk; trails = trials * walkers
